l1_connect_account.title: Bring unprotected sites into the recovery plan
l1_connect_account.why: Workloads run at this site, but nothing copies them or plans their recovery, so a failure there means rebuilding by hand.
steps: List the sites and the workloads at each, including branches.
Classify each workload with its recovery point and recovery time.
Connect the site to the protection platform and start the first copies.
l1_connect_account.success: Every site in scope has its workloads classified and copied.
